main.description: Writes a release that 'dev.zena-lang.host.publish' holds to its package, once the attestations of it meet the package's maintainers record: its 'threshold' of maintainers, of whom 'humans' are people, and an automation account the host holds counts only together with a person. Until then it answers how far they are from enough, and writes nothing. The caller must be a maintainer of the package.

version.description: The version of a release the host holds.

state.description: 'published' once the release record is in the package's repository.

approvedBy.description: The maintainers whose attestations name the release, in the maintainers record's order.

people.description: How many of them are people, not automation.

errors.name: ReleaseNotFound
errors.description: The host holds no release of that version, and the package has none: it was never published, was withdrawn, or waited longer than seven days.
